name: C411 Trend
author: XNinety9
description: C411 private tracker stats in the Omarchy bar: upload, download and ratio history, charts, forecasts and a what-if calculator ("20 TB uploaded in 2 months at this pace"). Reads your c411.org session cookie from your browser, locally; see SECURITY.md.

barWidget.description: C411 upload, download and ratio with history, forecasts and what-if targets.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Language of the panel, bar label and messages. Auto follows your session locale (LANG): French when it starts with fr, US English otherwise.

schema.label: Browser
schema.description: Where to read the c411.org session cookie. Auto: your default browser first, then every other one (native, Flatpak, Snap) until a live session turns up. File: ~/.config/c411trend/cookie, a Cookie header pasted from the browser's developer tools.

schema.label: Browser profile
schema.description: Profile directory (Default, Profile 1, default-release…). Empty = every profile, most recently used first.

schema.label: Poll interval (minutes)
schema.description: One request to /api/auth/me per interval. Each reading is appended to ~/.local/state/c411trend/history.jsonl.

schema.label: Pace window (days)
schema.description: Forecasts extend the linear trend of this period. Short reacts fast, long stays steady.

schema.label: Upload goal (TB)
schema.description: Always listed in the forecast with its estimated date. 0 = automatic milestones only. The what-if field answers one-off questions.

schema.label: Ratio goal
schema.description: Always listed in the forecast with its estimated date. 0 = automatic milestones only.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Template for the text next to the icon; mix any keys with free text, e.g. "↑{up} · {ratio}" or "{ratio} ({ratio7d}) · goal {goal}". Totals: {up} {down} {ratio} {credit} {buffer}. Pace: {rate} {downrate}. Change: {up24h} {up7d} {up30d} {down24h} {down7d} {down30d} {ratio24h} {ratio7d} {ratio30d}. Targets: {next} {nexteta} {goal} {ratiogoal}. Other: {user}. {{ and }} print braces. Empty = icon only.
